🏃 JumpRunner

An endless side-scrolling runner: your character auto-runs and you must jump over gaps and obstacles. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Press Space or tap the screen to jump.
  2. Time your jumps to clear gaps in the floor and obstacles ahead.
  3. The game speeds up gradually — stay focused.
  4. Hold longer jumps by holding the jump key/button longer.
  5. Watch for patterns in obstacles to anticipate upcoming gaps.
